description: Get institutional holders (13F filers) for a company. Returns institutions that hold positions in this stock based on SEC 13F filings, including shares held, portfolio weight, and filing dates. Useful for understanding institutional ownership concentration.

ticker.description: Company identifier: the current ticker (e.g. "AAPL"), a former ticker of a renamed or delisted company (e.g. "MIGI", now BGDE), or a numeric SEC CIK (e.g. "320193" or "0000320193"). A former ticker or a CIK is answered with a `resolvedFrom` block naming the current symbol.

name: get_institutions
title: Get Institutional Holders
